properties.decision: Found building phase 7 PR 4 (2026-10-22). A pin (external_dependency) naming another design is exact evidence the two touch, and PR 4 draws it as a computed edge FROM THE PIN NODE to the named design's most-connected node. A hub whose pins nothing in it is wired to (the PR 3 fixture's hub, and possibly hxm_program's) therefore still reads each member as a cut-off cluster beside the largest one: measured 118 before and 118 after on the 15-export fixture, 14 of them now filed under hub x member; with the hub's pins wired to one component, 119 -> 101 (fact:measured-computed-links-leave-the-fixtures-118-cut-off-clusters-because-the-hubs-pins-are-wired-to-nothing-2026-10-22). What the person sees: a hub that lists its members by pins and wires them to nothing gets one 'N nodes form a cluster with no traceability edge to the main body' per member, under the hub x member pair. Options: (a) keep it as built: the edge starts at the exact evidence, and the hub skill tells a hub owner to wire each pin to what uses it (the finding is then true: the pin is used by nothing); (b) a pin stands for its whole design: also draw from the pinning design's most-connected node, so a hub threads every member it pins (asserts a link inside the hub that nobody drew); (c) leave the edges as built and settle the cut-off class in dec:idea-a-composed-check-says-which-findings-only-the-composition-made's options (b) mark or (c) drop. Recorded as brainstorming, not a proposal. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: OPEN: in a composed check, does a pin thread only itself to the design it names, or the whole pinning design?
properties.rationale: The counter-argument to (b): an edge from the hub's busiest node to every member manufactures a relation the hub never stated, the failure dec:two-designs-are-linked-on-exact-evidence-and-a-similar-name-is-only-a-candidate exists to prevent; the counter-argument to (a): hxm_program's hub pins are its member list, and a hub owner may never wire them, so the composed check keeps reporting what composition made.
